abilities.desc_zh: 重击：
abilities.desc_en: Heavy Attacks:

abilities.title_en: {{var_1}} Chance to Confuse the opponent, lowering their Attack Rating by {{var_2}} and increasing the chance they will use a Special Attack for {{var_3}} or until their next Special Attack ends.
abilities.desc_zh: {{var_1}} 有机会迷惑对手，降低他们的攻击评级 {{var_2}}，并增加他们使用 {{var_3}} 特殊技的机会，或者直到他们的下一次特殊技结束。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_1}} Chance to Confuse the opponent, lowering their Attack Rating by {{var_2}} and increasing the chance they will use a Special Attack for {{var_3}} or until their next Special Attack ends.

abilities.title_en: If the opponent is not already Confused, Heavy Attacks grant {{var_4}} less Power to the opponent.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果对手尚未混乱，重击会给予对手 {{var_4}} 更少的力量。
abilities.desc_en: If the opponent is not already Confused, Heavy Attacks grant {{var_4}} less Power to the opponent.

abilities.desc_zh: 避免特殊技
abilities.desc_en: Avoiding Special Attacks

abilities.title_en: If Jazz avoids being struck by the first hit of a Special Attack he gains an Evasion Buff, granting a {{var_5}} chance to Evade all attacks for {{var_6}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 如果爵士避免被特殊技的第一击击中，他将获得回避增益，从而获得 {{var_5}} 的机会来回避 {{var_6}} 的所有攻击。
abilities.desc_en: If Jazz avoids being struck by the first hit of a Special Attack he gains an Evasion Buff, granting a {{var_5}} chance to Evade all attacks for {{var_6}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 组合仪表：
abilities.desc_en: Combo Meter:

abilities.title_en: Every 5 hits on the Combo Meter, Autobot Jazz gains a Critical Rate Buff, increasing Critical Chance by {{var_7}} until he is next hit.
abilities.desc_zh: 每击中连击计 5 次，汽车人爵士就会获得暴击率增益，将暴击率提高 {{var_7}}，直到他受到下一次击中。
abilities.desc_en: Every 5 hits on the Combo Meter, Autobot Jazz gains a Critical Rate Buff, increasing Critical Chance by {{var_7}} until he is next hit.

abilities.desc_zh: 热门歌曲
abilities.desc_en: Critical Hits

abilities.title_en: Critical Hits have +{{var_8}} Critical Damage against Stunned opponents.
abilities.desc_zh: 暴击对被眩晕的对手有 +{{var_8}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Critical Hits have +{{var_8}} Critical Damage against Stunned opponents.

abilities.desc_zh:
有时让困惑的对手疲惫不堪是值得的。

困惑的对手：困惑时，对手每次未命中的攻击都有 {{var_9}} 几率失去 {{var_10}} 的当前力量。如果对手的能量条下降到较低的水平，他们就会因 {{var_11}} 而被击晕。
abilities.desc_en:
Exhaustion
Sometimes it's worth letting a Confused opponent tire themselves out.
Confused Opponent: While Confused, opponents have a {{var_9}} chance to lose {{var_10}} of their Current Power for each missed attack. If the opponent slips down to a lower Bar of Power they are Stunned for {{var_11}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 爵士开始实施他的计划。
abilities.desc_en: Windmill - Jazz sets his plans in motion.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次击中困惑的对手都有 {{var_12}} 机会击晕对手 {{var_13}}。
abilities.desc_en: Each hit against a Confused opponent has a {{var_12}} chance to Stun the opponent for {{var_13}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 混乱比比皆是。
abilities.desc_en: Dazzling Display - Confusion abounds.
Allies – Ratchet, Grimlock - +{{var_18}}~{{var_19}} Armor.

abilities.title_zh: 敌人——威震天、红蜘蛛、大棒
abilities.desc_en: Enemies – Megatron, Starscream, Bludgeon - +{{var_20}}~{{var_21}} Attack Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 大黄蜂的重击为每个活着的团队成员获得 +{{var_22}}~{{var_23}} 攻击增益。
abilities.desc_en: Bumblebee's Heavy Attacks gain a +{{var_22}}~{{var_23}} Attack Buff for each alive team member.

abilities.desc_zh: Bumbelee 获得了一项新能力，并为他的榜样授予 +{{var_24}}~{{var_25}} 装甲值。
abilities.desc_en: Bumbelee gains a new ability and grants +{{var_24}}~{{var_25}} Armor to his role models.

abilities.desc_zh: 擎天柱获得 {{var_26}}~{{var_27}} 攻击力和装甲值，他的副官获得独特的能力。
abilities.desc_en: Lieutenants – Optimus Prime - Optimus gains {{var_26}}~{{var_27}} Attack and Armor and his Lieutenants gain unique abilities.

abilities.desc_zh: 每次爵士在对手的特殊技中避免所有命中，他都会获得攻击增益，在剩余的战斗中将他的攻击评级提高 {{var_28}}~{{var_29}}。
abilities.desc_en: Lieutenants – Optimus Prime - Each time Jazz avoids all hits in an opponent’s Special Attack he gains an Attack Buff, increasing his Attack Rating by {{var_28}}~{{var_29}} for the remainder of the fight.
+{{var_30}}~{{var_31}} Backfire Damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 当被击倒时，{{var_32}}~{{var_33}}有几率为{{var_35}}获得+{{var_34}}特殊伤害。每次击倒后增加 {{var_36}}。
abilities.desc_en: When Knocked Down, {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} chance to gain +{{var_34}} Special Damage for {{var_35}}. Increases by {{var_36}} after each Knock Down.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_37}} 临界评级。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_37}} Critical Rating.
